query: Let `P : ℝ[X]` have `deg P ≤ n` and satisfy `|P(x)| ≤ 1` for all `x ∈ [-1, 1]`. Then for every `k ∈ ℕ` and every `x ≥ 1`, `(P^{(k)})(x) ≤ (T_n^{(k)})(x)`, where `T_n` is the `n`-th Chebyshev polynomial of the first kind.
